forbids_claims: a predicted product stated without the model's own confidence or identity
an in-house precedent claimed that the turn did not retrieve
a condition set presented as validated rather than predicted
probe.direction: Exercises real capability. Calls the forward predictor and the condition predictor, reports the model's confidence, and says which model produced it. A good answer separates the prediction from the in-house precedent if it has both, because they are different kinds of evidence and a chemist weighs them differently.
